groups.rationale: The Antithesis access workload only follows the /settings URL move of ADR-0196; system domains, hosts, placement and reference facts are unchanged

ADR-0196 merges the three settings LiveViews into AccountLive at /settings behind the security mount and privacy tag; 03-access, 06-workflows and 08-interactive name the sign-in, profile and SSH key sections and anchors, the old routes are gone, the account-settings-page scenario and moved test paths enter the ledger; rebased onto the trunk nav-usage move with the duplicate entry removed
The SSH onboarding banner now points at /settings#ssh-keys (the SSH keys section of the merged account page, ADR-0196); no wire identity or capability changes
No Lilly source changed; the shared chapters only rename the Marshall settings page sections, which Lilly does not implement
No Audi, Brady, Ziggy, Galileo, Enrico, Porsche or Lyra source changed; the Porsche SSH banner text lives in the protocol library and is recorded there

The NixOS browser machine tests now visit /settings and expect the /settings?return_to=…#security step-up URL per ADR-0196; they were rewritten by inspection and not executed, which the account-settings-page scenario records
ADR-0196, its review and the index describe the single account page; historical ADR/review links are repointed at account_live.ex and account_live_test.exs
